title: Sauteed Chicken and Red Peppers
description: You don't have to sacrifice delicious meals when cooking for one--this sauteed chicken recipe using leftover chicken is big on taste but takes just 30 minutes to prepare.
ingredients: 0.5 red bell pepper, chopped into 1-inch pieces
1 pinch salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Place bacon in a large skillet and cook over medium-high heat, turning occasionally, until evenly browned, about 10 minutes. Remove bacon slices and drain on paper towels. When cool enough to handle, chop bacon into 1-inch pieces.

Add chicken, bell pepper, green onion, and bacon to the skillet. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook until bell pepper has softened and chicken is heated through, 7 to 10 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
